shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at 6 on the number line on the left with the mark at 1 on the number line on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed set includes 6 at its upper bound. Right image: The displayed set includes 1 at its lower bound.
Rationales: On the left, the filled endpoint marks an inclusive boundary of the marked ray. On the right, the filled endpoint marks an inclusive boundary of the marked ray.
